mapper.sql: id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, runtime_profile_uuid, provider_kind, session_external_id, remote_session_id, metric_unit, CAST(cumulative_amount AS double precision) AS cumulative_amount, CAST(delta_amount AS double precision) AS delta_amount, raw_usage, sampled_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_usage_records ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, runtime_profile_uuid, provider_kind, session_external_id, remote_session_id, metric_unit, cumulative_amount, delta_amount, raw_usage, sampled_at ) VALUES ( #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.RuntimeProfileUUID}, #{params.ProviderKind}, #{params.SessionExternalID}, #{params.RemoteSessionID}, #{params.MetricUnit}, #{params.CumulativeAmount}, #{params.DeltaAmount}, CAST(#{params.RawUsage} AS jsonb), #{params.SampledAt} ) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid, session_external_id, metric_unit, sampled_at) DO UPDATE SET cumulative_amount = EXCLUDED.cumulative_amount, delta_amount = EXCLUDED.delta_amount, raw_usage = EXCLUDED.raw_usage RETURNING
